pages.title: Adopting Domino
pages.text: Domino is a beloved companion feline available for adoption at any village for $(a)1 Emerald$(0).$(br2)Right-clicking triggers her signature meow. Her temporal affinity makes her the ideal alchemical vessel for time manipulation.

pages.title: Chrono Domino
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Domino$(br)$(bullet) Dragon's Breath$(br)$(bullet) Clock$(br)$(bullet) Trinitite$(br2)Right-click opens an interactive time dial allowing precise control over sunrise, midday, dusk, and midnight.

pages.title: Atmospheric Domino
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Domino$(br)$(bullet) Dragon's Breath$(br)$(bullet) Heart of the Sea$(br)$(bullet) Trinitite$(br2)Allows instantaneous control of world meteorological conditions: Clear skies, Downpour rain, and Thunderstorms.

pages.title: Chronospheric Domino
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Chrono Domino$(br)$(bullet) Atmospheric Domino$(br2)Fuses complete mastery over time and atmosphere. Features a godlike meow reverb, chronoshift freeze, and summons the devastating $(c)Ion Storm$(0) apocalyptic weather! Unlocking this final form awards the $(6)Domino Painting$(0)!
